name: product-view
description: A conversational lens that keeps the agent in product-space — describing what the human on the other side of the screen experiences — until you explicitly ask to cross into code-space.

interface.longDescription: Explain features, bugs, and plans through what people see and do. Grounds existing behavior in the actual artifact. Technical questions remain technical.
defaultPrompt: Use $product-view to explain this feature from the customer perspective.
